p1.title: Dry until the end

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: This site is a concept test run as part of a student project. No product is sold. Here is, plainly, what we measure and why.

purposes.body:
- To measure interest in the product depending on the price shown (price test), pseudonymously: a random identifier, without your name or email.
- To let you know about the launch, only if you leave your email and agree to it.

data.body:
- A random identifier, created by your browser and saved in its local storage (localStorage). It contains neither your name nor your email. Lifetime: 13 months at most, then it is replaced.
- Visit events: page view, click on "Pre-order", form submission, click to the questionnaire, with their date and time.
- The page language and the price shown.
- The source of the visit (UTM parameters of the link, e.g. instagram_story), otherwise "direct". The source of your first visit is also kept in your browser.
- Your email address, only if you give it and tick the consent box. It is kept separately from the statistics.
- Your IP address, only in hashed (unreadable) and temporary form, to limit abuse. It is never saved in plain text.

notCollected.body:
- No tracking cookies, no Google Analytics, no advertising pixel.
- No targeted advertising.
- No selling or sharing of your data for commercial purposes.
- No collection of card details or postal address.

legalBasis.body:
- Pseudonymous audience measurement (random identifier): our legitimate interest in evaluating the concept as part of the project. You can object to it (see "Opting out of measurement").
- Email: your consent, which you can withdraw at any time.

retention.body: All data (statistics and emails) is deleted no later than {deletionDate}. If you ask, your email is deleted sooner.

recipients.body:
Only the project team has access to the data. We use two technical processors:

- Vercel Inc. (website hosting, United States): data transfers are covered by the EU–US Data Privacy Framework.
- Turso (ChiselStrike Inc.): database, instance hosted in a European Union region.

The optional questionnaire is hosted by Tally (Tally BV, Belgium, European Union). The link to it only passes on the language, the price shown and the source of your visit, never your identifier or your e-mail: your answers cannot be linked to your visit to this site. What the questionnaire collects is explained on its first page.

rights.body:
You can ask to access, correct or erase your data, restrict its processing and receive your email in a portable format, object to its processing, or withdraw your consent, by writing to {contactEmail}.

If you believe your rights are not respected, you can lodge a complaint with the CNIL (French data protection authority): https://www.cnil.fr or with the data protection authority of your country.

optout.body: Click the button below: no more events are sent from this browser. The choice is saved in this browser: clearing this site's data cancels it.
optout.stateOn: Measurement is on for this browser.
optout.stateOff: Measurement is off: no more events are sent from this browser.
optout.failed: Your browser blocks local storage, so the choice could not be saved. Write to {contactEmail} to have your data deleted.
